verdict.rationale: Amazon SES documents an explicitly versioned API: the API Reference is published as 'APIReference-V2' and refers to the 'Amazon SES API v2'. Nothing in the pack describes a deprecation policy, sunset timelines, or how v1 relates to v2, so only half the story is evidenced. Missing for 10: a documented deprecation/sunset policy, version lifecycle or migration guidance, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy

citations.quote: You can use the Amazon SES API v2 to send the following types of messages: Simple ... Raw ... Templated
When you send this type of email, Amazon SES API v2 automatically replaces the tags with values that you specify.
